data.change_summary: Removed the redundant final schema-version restamp in `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs`. The migration loop already stamps each successful N→N+1 step, so migrated saves still deserialize at the current schema without the extra post-loop write, and current-version saves remain unchanged. Focused save/load and lint validation passed after the cleanup.
outstanding_risks: Known branch-level regression carried forward from prior validation: `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population hatch_produces_juveniles -- --exact` was still failing earlier on this branch with TAN rising to about 2.169 mg/L and no juvenile hatch; this save-loader cleanup did not address or revalidate that issue.

Known architectural issue carried forward from prior review: `Engine::step_hours` still calls `enforce_invariants(&mut self.state)` before returning some invariant errors, so a rejected step can still mutate live state.

steps.description: Inspected the approved review findings in the save migration loader and confirmed the only actionable code cleanup was the redundant post-loop `set_schema_version` call in `SaveFile::from_value`.
Removed the redundant final schema-version restamp from `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs`, preserving the existing per-migration version stamping behavior for legacy save upgrades.
Reran focused validation for save/load migration behavior and `tank_core` test-target clippy after the cleanup.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed: 15 tests passed, 0 failed.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.
